_comment: qa with the FLOW engine: autonomous, codebase-aware, deep FE+BE testing of a web+API stack behind a login. recon reads the repo, Mimo derives the real business flows, then drives the UI AND asserts the backend via authenticated api_request. set_port:false for multi-process stacks; aux_ports waits for the API. Login creds live ONLY in config/sentinel.env keyed by email_env/password_env. Copy to config/targets.json and adjust.

app.goal: Logged in as an admin for a TEST tenant (disposable data), exercise the core operator screens reachable from the dashboard. Verify pages load and render data without JS errors, lists/tables populate, filters and detail/edit views open, and the backend persists what the UI shows. Prefer viewing/navigating; you may open create/edit forms, but do NOT bulk-delete or wipe data.
